vendor.blurb: Stable Diffusion's original team: FLUX spans image, video, robotics; FLUX 3 Video is top 3

flux-3-video.tagline: An image veteran crosses over, top 3 in video
highlights: LMArena text-to-video 1493, #3, behind only Gemini Omni
Up to 20 seconds per clip with native audio; lip-sync in 14+ languages
9/10 added 2K/4K output and in-frame text rendering
flux-3-video.notes: Released 7/23, API fully open 8/4; BFL claims it beats Seedance 2.0. Entered the AA text-to-video v2.0 leaderboard at #5 on 9/30. The same base also spawned FLUX 3 Action, a 7B open robotics model.

bench.AA Text-to-Video v2.0（带音频）: #5 (5,628 samples); ahead of Gemini Omni Flash 1.1's 1120

flux-2-max.tagline: FLUX.2's top-quality tier, a developer favorite
highlights: Web-grounded generation; edits with up to 10 reference images
FLUX.2 [pro] and [flex] each passed 150K LMArena votes
flux-2-max.notes: Same-gen [pro] (1154, from $0.03/MP) and [flex] (1157, strong at typography) score similarly and are covered here.

highlights: Sub-second inference, as little as ~13GB VRAM
Self-serve LoRA fine-tuning; a go-to open base in the community
flux-2-klein.notes: Not in the image top 30; listed for its influence in the open-source ecosystem.
